parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to prevent hydrogen leakage through a valve seat without relying on a metal seat material that is susceptible to hydrogen embrittlement and permeation.
parsed.viable_reason: The proposed self-energizing FFKM conical seat is physically feasible with available materials and a testable leak-rate protocol, and it addresses the stated failure mode by replacing the embrittlement-prone metal sealing interface with an elastomer whose contact pressure increases with internal pressure.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: None of the cited prior art concerns hydrogen valve seat sealing, and the self-energizing elastomer/conical-annulus mechanism is not a routine parameter change to any of those unrelated interventions.
